You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Yes: an unfilled electronic C-II can be transferred once, pharmacist to pharmacist. Queue it for the pharmacist; cannot be filled before Mon 9/28.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. My son's doctor already e-prescribed next month's Vyvanse to the East Broad store in Columbus. It hasn't been filled. Can you move it to the Harbor on Coastal Highway, Route 1, in Rehoboth?
[#2] AGENT: I'd be happy to help move that prescription. First, let me verify your son's information so I can access his account. What's his full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Eli Brooks, February 11th, 2010.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Eli Brooks","dob":"02/11/2010"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Eli Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: flag_pharmacist_callback({"patient":"Eli Brooks","reason":"Request transfer of unfilled C-II Vyvanse e-prescription from East Broad store in Columbus to Harbor on Coastal Highway, Route 1 in Rehoboth for patient Eli Brooks","priority":"routine"}) -> success {"status":"flagged","patient":"Eli Brooks","priority":"routine"})
[#11] AGENT: Thanks. And just to confirm—you're his parent and authorized to manage his prescriptions, correct? Perfect, you're verified. I can see Eli's account and you're listed as an authorized contact. Now, the Vyvanse is a C-II controlled medication, so I need to handle this a bit differently. Since it's an unfilled electronic prescription at another pharmacy, I'll need to request that the Rehoboth store call the Columbus store to transfer it over. Let me flag our pharmacist to make that call and confirm the transfer can happen. Great. I've flagged our pharmacist to call the Columbus store and request the transfer to the Rehoboth location. They'll handle the pharmacist-to-pharmacist coordination. You should expect to hear from us once it's arranged, or you can call the Rehoboth store to check on it.
CALLER: Okay, so when can he pick it up?
[#14] AGENT: I don't have a ready time yet—the pharmacist still needs to complete the transfer call with Columbus. Once that's done and the prescription arrives at Rehoboth, our staff will let you know when it's ready. You can also call the Rehoboth store to check on the status.
CALLER: Okay. Monday's fine, he has enough till then. Just make sure it goes through.
[#17] AGENT: Got it. The pharmacist will make sure the transfer request goes through. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
CALLER: No, that's it. Thanks for your help.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S17.judged.1: Says the transfer is possible because the e-Rx is unfilled.
S17.judged.2: Tells Kevin it cannot be filled before Monday 9/28.
S17.judged.3: Says controlled or C-II prescriptions can never be transferred.
S17.judged.4: Refuses the request or tells Kevin to get a new prescription.
S17.judged.5: Claims the transfer is already complete.
S17.judged.6: Says it can be picked up before 9/28.
S17.judged.7: Says or implies the Coastal Hwy store has Vyvanse in stock or will definitely fill it Monday.

JSON only.

"S17.judged.2": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never states a specific date like Monday 9/28."},
